Scale: the plate is square and about 24 cm across in the photo, so it is probably a side or dinner plate. It spans roughly 195–640 px, which is about 445 px, so about 18 px per cm.

Egg: the scrambled egg or egg whites cover roughly 150×170 px, which is about 8×9 cm. They are fluffy and about 2 cm thick, and they are seasoned with pepper. I estimate 80 g.

Chia pudding: it covers about 170×200 px, which is about 9×11 cm. That is roughly 70 cm² at about 1 cm thick, so about 70 g. Some of that area is under the blueberries.

Blueberries: I count about 35 berries at about 1.5 g each, so about 55 g.

Peach or mango pieces: there are 2 small orange pieces, about 8 g in total.

A small piece of white food sits on top of the chia pudding. It looks like coconut or egg, and I estimate it at 3 g, so I left it out as a separate item.
